Detailed Description

This is the Monitoring report which RadarSS sends to the host, containing the measured Tx gain and phase mismatch values during an explicit monitoring chirp. RadarSS sends this to host at the programmed periodicity or when failure occurs, as programmed by the configuration API SB. Event: RL_RF_AE_MON_ADV_TX_GAIN_PHASE_MIS_REPORT.

◆ txPhaVal

rlUInt16_t rlMonAdvTxGainPhaMisRep_t::txPhaVal[12U]

The measured TX phase for each enabled channel, at each enabled RF
frequency is reported here.Byte numbers corresponding to different TX and
RF, in this field are here:
RF1 RF2 RF3
TX0 1:0 9:8 17:16
TX1 3:2 11:10 19:18
TX2 5:4 13:12 21:20
TX3 7:6 15:14 23:22
1 LSB = 360(degree)/2^16.
Only the entries of enabled RF Frequencies and enabled TX channels are
valid.
.

Note
: In the gains/phases reported here, only inter-TX mismatches carry information, and the raw values may include unknown biases (which cannot be relied on).
